title: Chapter 2: Lowood School and Helen Burns
chineseTitle: 第 2 章：洛伍德学校与海伦·麦克风的坚忍

paragraphs.en: Following my illness, Mrs. Reed eagerly arranged to send me away to Lowood Institution, a charitable boarding school for orphan girls. The treasurer of the school, Mr. Brocklehurst, was a cold, tyrannical hypocrite who preached austerity while his own family lived in luxury. At Lowood, eighty girls suffered under freezing temperatures, burnt porridge, and harsh discipline.
paragraphs.zh: 在我生病后，里德太太迫不及待地安排把我送到洛伍德学校（一家孤儿女孩慈善寄宿学校）。学校的财务主管布洛克赫斯特先生是一个冰冷专横的伪善者，他在自己家人生活奢华的同时宣扬苦行。在洛伍德，八十个女孩在冰冻的温度、烧焦的麦片粥和严酷的纪律下受苦。

paragraphs.en: Yet at Lowood I found two souls who gave me hope: Miss Temple, the sweet and dignified superintendent, and Helen Burns, a pious, thoughtful student older than myself. Helen bore the unjust punishments of strict teachers with stoic patience and quiet grace. When I wept over being falsely branded a liar by Mr. Brocklehurst, Helen comforted me, teaching me that self-respect and spiritual integrity were far more valuable than the praise of selfish mortals.
paragraphs.zh: 然而在洛伍德我发现了两个给我希望的灵魂：泰姆普尔小姐（甜美尊严的监督员）与海伦·麦克风（一位比我年长、虔诚深沉的学生）。海伦带着坚忍的耐心与安静的优雅忍受着严厉老师的不公正惩罚。当我因被布洛克赫斯特先生冤枉为谎言家而哭泣时，海伦安慰着我，教导我自尊与精神正直远比自私凡人的赞扬更有价值。

paragraphs.en: When a devastating typhus epidemic swept through Lowood during the damp spring, dozens of girls fell ill and died. Helen, already weakened by consumption, grew mortally sick. One night, I snuck into Miss Temple's room where Helen lay dying. I wrapped my arms around her neck, and she whispered softly: 'I am going home to my Father, Jane. Do not grieve.' When I awoke the next morning, my head was resting on Helen's shoulder, and her sweet soul had fled to heaven.
paragraphs.zh: 当一场毁灭性的伤寒流行病在潮湿的春天席卷洛伍德时，几十个女孩患病死去。已经被肺病削弱的海伦病入膏肓。一天晚上，我溜进泰姆普尔小姐的房间，海伦正躺在那里濒死。我用手臂环绕着她的脖子，她软软地低语：“我要回家去见我的父了，简。不要悲伤。”当我第二天早上醒来时，我的头正靠在海伦的肩膀上，而她甜美的灵魂已经飞向了天堂。
